app.db package¶

Submodules¶

app.db.database module¶

Database configuration and session utilities.

This module configures the SQLModel database engines, provides session dependencies for FastAPI, initializes database schemas, and exposes helper functions to retrieve database entities.

app.db.database.DATABASE_URL = 'sqlite:///database.db'¶

Main database connection URL.

app.db.database.TEST_DATABASE_URL = 'sqlite:///:memory:'¶

In-memory SQLite database URL used for testing.

Provide a database session dependency.

This function is used by FastAPI to inject a database session into request handlers.

app.db.database.init_db(test=False)[source]¶

Initialize the database schema.

Creates all database tables based on SQLModel metadata.

Parameters:

test (bool) – If True, initialize the test database. Otherwise, initialize the production database.

app.db.database.test_engine = Engine(sqlite:///:memory:)¶

SQLModel engine configured for test execution.

Uses a static pool to allow multiple connections to the same in-memory database.

app.db.models module¶

Database models definition.

This module defines all SQLModel entities used by the application, including users, accounts, beneficiaries, deposits, withdrawals, and transfers. These models represent the database schema and their relationships.

app.db.models.ACCOUNTS_TABLE_ID = 'accounts.id'¶
